lines.text: I hear your voice, even in the distance, even in the silence, even in the static. I see you move. Even in the dark night, even in the half-light, even in the stillness. And after the fire, and after the wind, when chaos subsides, I listen again. And after the earth shakes, you're calling me in. A voice in the quiet, a whisper within. When you speak, I am still. I believe you are near. Speak to me, draw me in. Where you are, I'll remain. I feel your love even in the heartache. Even though my heart breaks, even in your worst days, I know you're here. Even when I'm broken, Even when I'm hopeless, I know where my hope is. When you speak, I am still. I believe you are near. Speak to me, Lord. Draw me in. Where you are, I'll remain.
lines.text_sk: Počujem tvoj hlas, aj z diaľky, aj v tichu, aj v šume. Vidím ťa pohybovať sa. Aj v tmavej noci, aj v polotme, aj v nehybnosti. A po ohni, a po vetre, keď chaos utíchne, opäť počúvam. A po tom, ako sa zem otriasa, voláš ma. Hlas v tichu, šepot vnútri. Keď hovoríš, som ticho. Verím, že si blízko. Hovor so mnou, pritiahni si ma. Kde si ty, tam zostanem. Cítim tvoju lásku aj v bolesti srdca. Aj keď sa mi srdce láme, aj vo tvojich najhorších dňoch, viem, že si tu. Aj keď som zlomený, aj keď som bez nádeje, viem, kde je moja nádej. Keď hovoríš, som ticho. Verím, že si blízko. Hovor so mnou, Pane. Pritiahni si ma. Kde si ty, tam zostanem.

lines.text: 'Cause there is joy in your presence. There is peace in your presence.
